apps.localizedDescription:
A free and open source YouTube Music client for iOS.

• No ads
• Stream songs and videos from YouTube Music
• Background playback with lock screen controls
• Equalizer & audio normalization
• Video mode
• Queue management & listening history
• Discord status – show current song
• Last.fm scrobbling
• Synced lyrics (Musixmatch, Netease, Kugou, LRCLIB, Genius)
• Library sync (playlists, albums, artists, podcasts)
• Downloads
• Custom app icons

Requires iOS 26 or later and a YouTube Music account.
